messages:
Sam (SupplyOps): Heads-up: vendor reported 2 H100s DOA on return leg. They recommend consolidating the RMAs into one to reduce fees. Need quick decision because eu-west provisioning might be impacted.
Eve (Logistics): Can we get AWBs? consolidation usually saves ~$600 but may add 1 business day.
Sam (SupplyOps): AWBs:
```
MAWB-proposal: SF-MAWB-7788
AWB: SF-99888 (25kg), SF-99889 (23kg)
Carrier ETA if consolidated: 2026-05-04
```
Diego (Infra): Those are bound for eu-west spare pool. Thermal hold is ~72h; if they exceed that we risk node reprovisioning delay. If consolidation adds >24h, I'll trigger spare swap.
Nina (Procurement): Vendor suggests declared value $220k. I'll chase invoice proof and ask for brokerage credit.
ops-bot: RMA created: RMA-8821. Please attach photos and manifest.
Eve (Logistics): I'll push SkyFreight to confirm consolidated house manifest and try to secure brokerage reduction to <$250. If they hold firm, consolidation still saves us money.
Sam (SupplyOps): Action list: Eve confirm final brokerage (EOD), Nina get invoice lines + vendor credit, Diego standby for spare swap.
Diego (Infra): I'll prepare crossdock routing from DE spares if needed and enable dashboard alert for spare depletion at 50% threshold.
Nina (Procurement): Vendor replied: "We can credit $300 if paperwork error." Pushing for $600.
Sam (SupplyOps): Proceed with consolidation if brokerage <= $350 and manifest uploaded. Otherwise ship separate. Will update INC-2026-188.
